scope: Individual bibliographic and source-type checks. Retrieval does not validate all claims, translations, editions or pedagogical assignments.

SRC-HW-CORE-ECON2.rationale: Official textbook page identifies the CORE Econ team, institutional focus and comparative examples; introductory rather than specialist empirical evidence.
SRC-HW-CORE-ECON2.license_status: CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0; reference-only; not relicensed under repository CC-BY
SRC-HW-CORE-ECON2.limitations: This check verifies source identity and declared scope/license, not every model, historical case or educational outcome. Compare primary and specialist evidence.

SRC-ML-HPL2.rationale: National Academies consensus study report; its front matter identifies committee authorship and independent review.
SRC-ML-HPL2.limitations: A synthesis, not a trial of Obelisk. Applications require contextual adaptation; learning populations and settings matter.

SRC-DR-NIELSEN.rationale: Author-maintained statement of Nielsen's own heuristic framework; primary for the framework, not a consensus empirical law.
SRC-DR-NIELSEN.limitations: Broad rules of thumb. Evaluation must include actual users, accessibility, context and consequences.

SRC-HW-LEG-002.rationale: Imported practitioner persuasion title; cannot carry general causal claims about social interaction.
SRC-HW-LEG-002.limitations: Retained as legacy context, not a rigorous empirical spine. Bibliographic edition and evidence base need review.

SRC-HW-LEG-003.rationale: Imported popular interpersonal-advice title; distinguish advice from replicated social evidence.
SRC-HW-LEG-003.limitations: Not a substitute for comparative sociology, consent or ethical judgment. Edition and claims remain unverified.
